name: Data from module evaluations (students and tutors) from 2019 to 2022 including Gamification data and Algo-counter data
description: Data for publications "Heterogenitätsbewusste Digitale Gestaltung Eines Einführungsmoduls in Der Informatik" and "Cooperative Gamification in a Computer Science Introductory Module", referenced in chapter 5. Additional data used for chapter 6. Module evaluation data at the end of the semester: - Winter semester 2018/19 - from StudIP - Winter semester 2019/20 - from LimeSurvey - Winter semester 2020/21 - from LimeSurvey - Winter semester 2021/22 - from LimeSurvey Weekly evaluation data for Coding Classes for winter semester 2019/20 Written interview data with student tutors: - Winter semester 2019/20 - Winter semester 2020/21 - Winter semester 2021/22 Group interview protocol with selected student tutor on the basis of written interview from winter semester 2019/20 Algo-counter data from 10/19/2020 to 02/22/2021 (winter semester 2020/21)

citation.name: Ossovski, Elisaweta, Michael Brinkmeier, Ann-Katrin Becker, Laura Hembrock, Daniel Kalbreyer, und Sven Klecker. 2022. «Heterogenitätsbewusste Digitale Gestaltung Eines Einführungsmoduls in Der Informatik». MedienPädagogik: Zeitschrift für Theorie Und Praxis Der Medienbildung 48 (Digitalisierung als Katalysator):170-90. https://doi.org/10.21240/mpaed/48/2022.06.14.X.

Elisaweta Ossovski, Daniel Kalbreyer, Laura Hembrock, and Michael Brinkmeier. 2022. Cooperative Gamification in a Computer Science Introductory Module.
